traits: Cap 5 to 15 cm, dull yellow to ochre or rusty, felted and speckled with small scales, barely sticky
Fairly large pores, ochre then olive-brown
Stem 4 to 12 cm, nearly smooth, the colour of the cap or paler, no ring
Cream to yellowish flesh, which may turn slightly blue near the tubes; chlorine-like smell and taste
Only under pines, on sandy soil poor in lime
safetyNote: Edible but mediocre: the DGfM and the VAPKO list it. Wikipedia (fr) finds the flesh flabby, the chlorine smell passing into the dish, and says it can be laxative; it advises young firm ones, the stem removed, the cap peeled and a small first portion. It strongly accumulates caesium-137 and metals (Wikipedia, fr). The bovine bolete has a plain, paler cap and a slimmer stem (Wikipedia, fr). Wikipedia (en) calls its smell and taste unpleasant.

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Positivliste der Speisepilze, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
VAPKO, Vereinigung amtlicher Pilzkontrollorgane der Schweiz (2023). Empfehlungsliste (liste des champignons recommandés), version 09.2023.
